- **完成标准：** 打开克隆即有可用的默认名称。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U08**, ruled as a fold into #13159. That card closed `completed` on 2026-10-20T08:07Z, before the ruling: it gave the activation badge a "Not running here" state (the chip half's "or use it for Not bound"), but the clone dialog still opens with both names empty, so the remaining half is filed here (see *Why*). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Packaged Automation, the system administrator.
- **Round 1:** a grey "On" chip beside every green switch (33 redundant chips), and Clone opens with both names empty; a clone failed once on a name the form could have proposed. Evidence: objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-08; [`sweep-03-packaged-automation.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/sweep-03-packaged-automation.png), [`03-apps-packaged-automation-clone-dialog.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/03-apps-packaged-automation-clone-dialog.png).
- **What #13159 landed (PR #13185):** the badge reads "Not running here" for an unarmed flow, which is the suggestion's "or use it for Not bound". The clone names were not in scope.

## Landing

- Clone opens with the name `<source>_copy` and the label "<source label> (copy)", both editable; a taken name still answers the existing 409 message.
- A page test on the prefill.
